name: Basemath
title: Esau's wife and daughter of Ishmael
summary: Basemath is known as one of Esau's wives. In Genesis 36, she is identified as the daughter of Ishmael and sister of Nebajoth, and she became the mother of Reuel. The name Basemath appears several times in Genesis, which has sparked discussion about identification, since another Basemath is mentioned as the daughter of Elon the Hittite.

keyEvents.title: Esau's marriage to Basemath
keyEvents.description: Esau took Basemath, the daughter of Ishmael and sister of Nebajoth, as his wife, in addition to his other wives. This marriage was likely an attempt to please his parents after they disliked his Hittite wives.

keyEvents.title: Basemath as the daughter of Ishmael
keyEvents.description: Basemath is identified as the daughter of Ishmael, Abraham's son, which links Esau's family to Ishmael's lineage.

keyEvents.title: Basemath Bears Reuel
keyEvents.description: Basemath became the mother of Reuel, who became the ancestor of several Edomite clans and chiefs.

keyEvents.title: Reuel's Sons and Edomite Chiefs
keyEvents.description: Through her son Reuel, Basemath became the matriarch of several Edomite chiefs, including Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.

keyEvents.title: Esau's Attempt to Please Isaac and Rebekah
keyEvents.description: Esau realized that his Canaanite wives displeased his father Isaac, so he went to Ishmael to take Basemath (here called Mahalath) as a wife.
